amendments: ROOT D1: raw RTP only, no core presentationTimeUs
ROOT D2: anchor earliest sample unaffected by decoder/backend waits; use core enqueue where callback can block
ROOT D4: off default until device receipts; auto and source_time qualify or fall back

requested.auto: qualified source-time pacing, fallback reason recorded

rtpTimestamp.source: raw RTP after byte-order conversion, before division; never synthetic

anchorUs: client monotonic reassembly enqueue where callback can block; callback ingress diagnostic only; ms quantization explicit
